text: The first real thread-scaling run gave each hmmer-split part a private 2-core lease on michi 0.1.0; its record is in tmp-claude/thread-scaling-michi-0.1/. At 48 threads hmmer-split reached 48% of perfect speedup on MGnify and 54% on Swissprot. An earlier 1,000-family set finished nail in 17.6 s at 48 threads, which is why the set grew to all of Pfam.
